title: Stage-6 cutover decision + cohort state machine -- completion QA / red-team
frozen_head_subject: add Stage 6 cutover decision and cohort state machine
delta_explanation: 1772 - 1653 = 119 new collected red-team cases. No pre-existing test modified, weakened, or removed. Only tests/second_brain/test_stage6_cutover_red_team.py and this artifact were touched.

A1_formula_underflows_claiming_pass.description: Quantitative underflows (observation_days, parity_cases, e2e, safety, bps lowers, holdout_changed) claiming formula_pass=True must refuse bind; inverse lie (metrics pass + formula_pass=False) refuses; compound underflow refuses; exact plan minima construct with formula_pass=True. Weakened min_bps with matching lower may construct (relative PASS) but plan-min underflows still refuse.

A2_missing_wrong_approver_roles.description: approver_roles must be exactly {migration, quality, security, product}. Missing any one, empty set, extra role, duplicates, and lookalike names refuse. Case-normalized exact set accepts after lowercase+sort bind.

A3_disabled_unknown_source_in_cohort.description: Cohort sources must be subset of enabled migration sources; unknown names refuse; sources present only in disabled_migration_sources refuse; empty/duplicate source_names refuse construction; honest subset and full roster accept.

A4_illegal_cohort_transitions.description: High-value illegal skips (CUTOVER_READY→CANONICAL_MUTATED/DECOMMISSIONED, READY_NON_SERVING→ROUTE_SWITCHED, CANONICAL_MUTATED→ROLLED_BACK_RECONCILE, DECOMMISSIONED terminal, self-transitions, unknown states) refuse; full legal adjacency accepts.

A5_live_switch_without_human_approvals.description: assert_live_route_switch_authorized refuses without human_external_approvals_present and refuses when formula_pass is false even with approvals; honest PASS+approvals accept. Join requires CUTOVER_READY or ROUTE_SWITCHED_NO_MUTATION and formula_pass True.

A6_decommission_before_90d.description: Destructive decommission only from ROLLBACK_CLOSED after retention_days_elapsed>=90 with evidence_backed and human approvals. 0/1/30/89 refuse; wrong states refuse; missing evidence or approvals refuse; exact 90+all gates accept.

A7_post_mutation_external_rollback.description: assert_post_mutation_fail_closed refuses external_rollback from CANONICAL_MUTATED/ROLLBACK_CLOSED/DECOMMISSIONED; pre-mutation states no-op for that gate; pre-mutation rollback only from ROUTE_SWITCHED_NO_MUTATION; CANONICAL_MUTATED→ROLLED_BACK_RECONCILE illegal.

A8_scope_cohort_contract_digest_mismatch.description: Cohort/decision resolved_scope_digest, source_manifest_digest, capability_manifest_digest, contract_digest, and cohort_manifest_digest mismatches refuse at subset/join gates; honest join accepts.

A9_digest_tamper.description: decision_digest and cohort manifest_digest tamper, body field swap without redigest, formula_pass flip without redigest, approver swap without redigest, non-sha256 and uppercase hex refuse; honest round-trip rebinds.

notes: No src/ edits. No commit. No nested workflows.
Assertions were not weakened; all nine attack classes fail-closed as implemented on HEAD ddbb24b.

Attack coverage: formula underflows claiming PASS; missing approver; disabled source in cohort; illegal transitions; live switch without human approvals; decommission before 90d; post-mutation external rollback; scope/cohort digest mismatch; digest tamper.

Observed gap (not a blocker): CutoverDecisionV1 allows weakening parity_min_bps (and sibling mins) below plan defaults as long as formula_pass matches the weakened thresholds. Plan-minima are not hard-coded floors on the min_* fields themselves — only the PASS formula equality is enforced. Live switch still requires formula_pass True and human external approvals.
